name: The Righteous
description: The Righteous was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that served in the Republic Navy. The Righteous fell in battle with the acclaimed Admiral Trench prior to the Battle of Christophsis of 22 BBY. As a member of the Venator-class, it was 1,137 meters in length.
